name: passkeyAuthenticate
description: Starts signing a user in with an existing passkey. Call CFPasskey.startAuthentication() in JavaScript to prompt the browser.

params.name: userStruct
params.description: Struct with optional keys username (omit to let the user choose from all passkeys for the site), rpId and userVerification.

params.name: configStruct
params.description: Struct with optional keys successHandler and errorHandler (JavaScript function names), redirectUrl (page that receives ?passkey_token=) and service (CFC used to store credentials; defaults to /CFIDE/passkey/DefaultPasskey.cfc, which is for development only).
